values: Uniform relative FPRAS with exact zero detection, and total-variation approximate weighted perfect-matching sampling, for every even-order symmetric matrix with nonnegative rational off-diagonal entries encoded in binary. Cover empty/zero inputs, disconnected support, weights below one, large denominators and arbitrarily small positive hafnians.

Nonnegative binary rational hafnians: an exact reduction and approximation and sampling consequences — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X). Preprint date 2026-10-06; production Zenodo publication verified 2026-10-07 UTC. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23205294. Attributed exact reduction and implementation note: binary rational weight removal is classical (Dell and collaborators; McQuillan), count-to-sampling is classical (Jerrum–Valiant–Vazirani), and the unweighted FPRAS is OpenAI family113. Proves polynomial bit bounds, relative-epsilon accuracy with failure at most delta, exact zero detection, and an always-feasible TV-eta sampler with polynomial dependence on eta inverse. No first-solution, new reduction or new complexity classification claim. Five complete automated review cycles; fresh exact v5 PASS after repairs. Independent Lean kernel rebuild not reproduced; finite tests do not certify the upstream FPRAS. Extensive AI assistance; no conventional human peer review. Nonnegative rational scope only.
